description: Start the full checkup of a website: site speed, agent readiness, and Open Service Profile conformance. Two more checks run when their inputs are given: city enables AI visibility. placeId enables local rank. Provide businessName and state for accurate identification. A finished result is saved and reused for seven days. The user is never charged. The checkup has a limited daily allowance shared by everyone, so it may be unavailable later in the day. If the allowance cannot cover the whole request, nothing starts and the result says quota_reached with the reset time (UTC); the individual check tools may still answer. For a running result, call get_audit_report with runId. That call waits up to about 40 seconds for the run to finish before it answers. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

city.description: City. Needed for the AI visibility check.

placeId.description: Google Place id. Needed for the local rank grid.

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.

name: start_audit
title: Run a full checkup
